thread:
Owen T.: Hey folks, landed my kit this morning. Dock powers my monitor but the USB hub isn't enumerating my headset (no /dev sound device) and the HDMI output to my 4k TV flickers every few minutes. Also can't join CompanyCorp-Enterprise wifi: it prompts for a client cert I don't have. Filed ticket IT-5001. Any quick checks I can run?

Nate (IT): welcome Owen! Quick checks: plug the headset directly into the laptop to confirm it's not the headset. Try a different HDMI cable if you have one. For the USB hub, run `system_profiler SPAudioDataType` (Mac) or `arecord -l` (Linux) and paste err output. For 802.1X cert, try Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll Device.

Owen T.: plugged headset directly into Mac — works fine. HDMI cable is the thin passive one that came with the kit. system_profiler shows no USB audio devices when dock is connected. `arecord` not relevant (mac).

Nate (IT): sounds like the dock's USB controller didn't enumerate the audio endpoint, and the passive HDMI may be dropping signal at 4k. Two options: I can ship an active HDMI 2.0 cable + a USB-A->C 3.1 cable + a small USB audio dongle as fallback, or you can bring the laptop to the office for a bench flash. Which works? Also I'll attach the enrollment token to the ticket so you can install the client cert.

Priya S.: fwiw I had a similar flicker — replacing the cable fixed it. The USB audio dongle is handy as a temporary fix for calls.

Owen T.: Remote in SF, so please ship the kit. If the dongle works I'll be fine for calls. Thanks.

it-bot: Ticket IT-5001 updated by Nate (IT): "Shipping active HDMI, USB-C cable, and USB audio dongle; enrollment token attached."

Nate (IT): order placed — Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1Z777ZZ40456789012 ETA 2 business days. If the dongle doesn't make the audio show up we may schedule a remote session to run a firmware flash script. Reopen the ticket if anything changes.

Owen T.: Appreciate it :pray: I'll report back once the kit arrives and I test audio + HDMI.
